verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not show Google Cloud generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product. Vertex AI is described as a foundation for building agents, and MCP Toolbox for Databases lets external AI clients query databases. Both are developer building blocks or external-agent connectors, not an in-product insights capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
